handoff: Approve: main.ts waits for stderr/stdout write callbacks before exit; verified old 65536 vs new 100237 bytes through a pipe, early-closing reader does not hang; stdout-pipe.test.ts proves it. One nit (test runs source, not built binary).

findings.title: Test runs main.ts from source, not the built binary
findings.detail:
The issue's Where says 'add a test that pipes a >64 KiB value through the built binary'. The test runs `bun packages/cli/src/main.ts`, which is the same entry code the bundle wraps; the smoke script covers the built artifacts. Not worth a rework round.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optional: add a >64 KiB pipe check to scripts/smoke.sh later.
